title: Coin-Ops multicloud lab config
description: Single source of truth for the lab. Terraform reads this via locals.config.tf and dispatches to modules/<cloud>-stack. Flip `cloud:` to retarget the whole stack.

cloud.description: Active backend cloud. Drives which stack module Terraform builds (aws|gcp|azure). One cloud per apply/workspace.

location.description: Logical region key, resolved per-cloud via catalog.locations[<this>]. e.g. eu_central -> gcp:europe-central2 / azure:eastus2.

name_prefix.description: Prefix applied to every resource name. Keep short; some clouds cap name length.

clouds.description: Per-cloud settings (project ids, k3s_only flags, GKE). Only the active `cloud:` block is used.

project_id.description: GCP project id that owns every resource.

k3s_only.description: Build only network + bastion + k3s VMs (self-managed Kubernetes). Mutually exclusive in spirit with gke.enabled.

gke.description: Managed Kubernetes (GKE). When enabled, Terraform stands up a VPC-native GKE cluster + node pool in the lab VPC. The headline of the GCP chapter.

enabled.description: Provision the GKE module. Default false.

node_machine_type.description: Compute Engine machine type for node-pool nodes (e.g. e2-medium = 2 vCPU / 4 GB).

pods_cidr.description: Secondary range CIDR for pod IPs (VPC-native).

services_cidr.description: Secondary range CIDR for service IPs (VPC-native).

subnet_cidr.description: Primary CIDR for the dedicated GKE node subnet.

runtime.description: How the app's backing services are provided (external containers vs cloud-native managed). See locals.config.tf runtime_mode.

mode.description: external = in-VM/in-cluster containers; cloud-native = managed DB/queue/cache.

app.description: App-level config + which named instances fill each role.

nodes.description: Maps roles to instance keys defined under `instances`.

k3s.description: k3s node instance keys. Empty when using GKE instead.

catalog.description: Cloud-agnostic lookup tables: locations, machine sizes, db sizes, images. Instances reference these by key.

instances.description: Named VMs. Each has a role (-> roles[]), optional size/image/subnet, and a private_ip.
